  • Ori bubbly-inspired glitter in a classic quilt exterior
  • Adjustable woven crossbody strap
  • Interior zipper and credit card pocket
  • Magnetic closure
  • 8 3/4” (Base Width) x 6 ½” (H) x 2 1/4” (D), 14 - 27 1/2" handle drop
  • Made in Mexico
